sources.quote: COAT-ZN-YELLOW,Zinc 8 um with yellow chromate passivation,Zinc;CrVI

findings.why: The proposed 'yellow chromate passivation' on CL-115 corresponds to COAT-ZN-YELLOW, which the coating catalogue lists as containing hexavalent chromium (CrVI). CrVI is a substance restricted by law. The current coating, COAT-ZNNI, uses Cr(III) instead. No document states the part's market, so a person should confirm it. The documents also do not show which coating the proposal means: COAT-ZN-YELLOW (zinc) or COAT-CCC-YELLOW (aluminium only). The CL-115 clip is spring steel, so the zinc version is the one that fits.

sources.quote: Lot 26-0412 of CL-115 clips in C67S spring steel measured 52 HRC, tolerance 44-50 HRC.

findings.why: The source for CL-115, SUP-G, has an open NCR on the C67S spring steel of this part. A lot measured 52 HRC against a tolerance of 44-50 HRC. The lot is blocked and the next three lots need a 100% hardness check.
